Name: Konbit Work Events API

Environments.Name: production
Environments.Description: Production demo (PayPal sandbox, no real money)

Description:
Send proof of work (a merged pull request, a client's approval email, a finished
calendar session, an Upwork or Notion update) to your Konbit workspace. Claude
reviews it, matches it to an open milestone and proposes a PayPal payout. The
server then applies your signed mandate: the payout is sent at once, waits for
your approval, or is blocked.

Evidence is treated as untrusted text. It can never add a payee or raise a limit.

Use the generated SDKs from Zapier steps, GitHub Actions or your own scripts.

Parameters.Name: X-Konbit-Key
Parameters.Description: Workspace key from Mandate → Work-event webhook. It is shown once when created.

Endpoints.Name: submitWorkEvent
Endpoints.Description:
Stores the evidence, asks the Konbit agent (Claude) to review it, and returns the
review together with any payout plans it created. A plan's `decision` tells you
what the signed mandate allowed: `auto` (paid with PayPal Payouts), `ask`
(waiting for the freelancer's approval) or `block` (refused by policy).
Endpoints.Summary: Submit work evidence for the agent to review

application/json.Description: The agent's review of one piece of evidence.
application/json.Example: {"event_id":12,"status":"done","risk":"low","summary":"PR #42 was merged and the client confirmed the landing page is live. I proposed Jean's $250.00 milestone.","plans":[{"plan_id":7,"title":"Jean Pierre · Landing page live","total_cents":25000,"decision":"ask","status":"needs_approval"}]}

400.Name: response400
400.Description: The body is not valid JSON.

application/json.Example: {"error":"unauthorized","message":"Send your workspace key in the X-Konbit-Key header."}

413.Name: response413
413.Description: The body is larger than 50 KB.

422.Name: response422
422.Description: The evidence was rejected (for example, too short) or could not be reviewed.

429.Name: response429
429.Description: Rate limited (20 events per hour per workspace).

CustomTypes.Name: EventStatus
CustomTypes.Description: Review result: done = payout proposed, ignored = no action, flagged = suspicious.

CustomTypes.Name: RiskLevel
CustomTypes.Description: How risky the agent and the risk scan judged the evidence.

CustomTypes.Name: PlanDecision
CustomTypes.Description: What the signed mandate decided for a payout plan.
